'''Czic''' was one of [[Chay Praysh]]'s numerous [[Drach'nam]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. He, along with [[Brok (Drach'nam)|Brok]], was sprayed in the face with a flammable mix of chemicals by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], during her mission to rescue [[Sansia Bardrin]] from [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].
